title: Co-op, any combination (0.9.171-dev1): both players on pawns, robot as player 2
intro: Keyboard and mouse for you; one controller connected or none. Open ground, no enemies near, a full party (at least two pawns, both standing), playing the Arisen, nothing taken over. The robot plays player 2. About 2.5 minutes. Press End (keyboard) when ready.

steps.text: Get ready (see the intro). Press End, then hands off until a step asks for you.
Starting co-op on your main pawn. The robot plays player 2.

expect.label: co-op is on (classic: P1 Arisen, P2 a pawn)

steps.text: Both on pawns: YOU (player 1) take the second pawn, the robot (player 2) keeps the main pawn. The Arisen goes on his AI.

expect.label: both-pawns arrangement is up
player 2's pawn is held by the second slot
player 2's pawn's controls run every frame
no errors in player 2's pawn's controls
your pawn is the second pawn
the Arisen is on DPC's AI
Camera Distance is told to frame your pawn and player 2's

steps.text: Robot (player 2) pushes its stick: the MAIN pawn should walk, yours stands.

expect.label: player 2's stick moves player 2's pawn
player 2's stick does not move your pawn
player 2's pawn attacks
player 2's buttons reach the pawn's input

steps.text: YOUR TURN: walk your pawn around with WASD and attack with the mouse a few times (the controller is player 2's in this test). 10 seconds.

expect.label: you move your pawn
player 2's pawn stays put while the robot is idle

steps.text: Three tough goblins. The robot fights with player 2's pawn, the Arisen fights on his own, you fight too. 25 seconds.

expect.label: the Arisen attacks on his own
player 2's pawn fights
player 2's pawn picks targets
no DPC errors in the fight
no errors in player 2's controls

steps.text: Player 2 (robot) goes to its next character.

expect.label: player 2 moved on to another pawn
no errors

steps.text: YOUR TURN: press F6 to go to your next character, again and again until you are the Arisen (watch the name line). Press End when you are the Arisen.
Checking: you on the Arisen, player 2 on a pawn (classic co-op).

expect.label: back to classic co-op
player 2's pawn is played
co-op off
second slot empty
main pawn's AI is back on
second pawn's AI is back on

steps.text: Done. Tell Claude what looked wrong (camera, HUD, controls).

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.cerrs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/CameraDistance.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.mode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cp and ((D.R.cp.on and D.R.cp.mode) or 'off')
probes.who: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local c = D and D.R.cp; if not (c and c.on) then return 'off' end; local n = c.names or {}; return 'P1 ' .. tostring(n[1]) .. ' / P2 ' .. tostring(n[2])
probes.s2a: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.R.s2.active == true
probes.s2f: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.s2.frames or 0
probes.s2e: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and ((D.R.s2.errors or 0) + ((D.R.s2.in_err and 1) or 0) + ((D.R.s2.failed and 100) or 0)) or 0
probes.s2err: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.R.s2.err or D.R.s2.in_err or '')
probes.s2idx: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.s2.active and D.R.s2.idx or -1
probes.s2on: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.s2.last_on or 0
probes.s2tgt: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.s2.tgt_sets or 0
probes.poss: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.state.active == true
probes.mainidx: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.state.active and D.state.pawn_idx or -1
probes.coopjs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and string.format('%s pawn %s anchor %s', tostring(d.active), tostring(d.pawn_idx), tostring(d.anchor_idx))
probes.brain: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.brain.on == true
probes.shots: local b = H.dpc_brain(); return b and ((b.presses or 0) + (b.skill_uses or 0)) or 0
probes.ai0: local p = H.pawn(0); local ok, v = pcall(function() return p:call('get_AIDecisionMaker'):call('get_DecisionModule'):call('get_IsSkipThink') end); return ok and v
probes.ai1: local p = H.pawn(1); local ok, v = pcall(function() return p:call('get_AIDecisionMaker'):call('get_DecisionModule'):call('get_IsSkipThink') end); return ok and v
probes.camt: local ok, n = pcall(function() local m = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.CameraManager'):call('getMainCameraController', 0); return m:call('get_TargetObject'):call('get_Name') end); return ok and n
probes.cplog: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local L = D and D.R.cp.log; return L and L[#L]
probes.s2drv: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local s = D and D.R.s2; return s and string.format('%s hook %d in %d mir %d', s.drive_pre and 'pre' or 'player', s.hook_frames or 0, s.hook_input or 0, s.mirror_input or 0)
